name: Strix
tagline: Open-source AI agents that pentest your app and prove findings.
insight: Open-sourced in late 2025 under Apache-2.0; surpassed 25k GitHub stars within months of launch.
description: Strix runs autonomous AI agents that behave like real attackers: they execute your code dynamically, explore the app through an HTTP proxy and headless browser, and surface vulnerabilities — then validate each with a working proof-of-concept instead of a static-analysis guess. It runs locally via Docker from the CLI, against a local codebase, a GitHub repo, or a black-box web target, with a hosted cloud version and GitHub Actions integration for CI.

modelSupport.notes: Bring your own LLM provider key (OpenAI / Anthropic / Google).

edge: Runs the app and confirms each vulnerability with a working proof-of-concept, cutting the false positives static scanners produce.
pros: Runs locally via Docker or cloud
cons: Requires your own LLM API key

references.title: Strix: Open-source AI agents for penetration testing
